name: Kerioth
overview: Kerioth is identified in Scripture as both a city within the tribe of Judah and a city of Moab, also referred to as Kirioth. In Joshua 15:25, it is listed among cities in Judah, while Jeremiah 48:24 and 48:41 describe Kerioth in Moab as a stronghold that will be overtaken and devastated. Amos 2:2 further emphasizes God's judgment on Moab by sending fire upon the palaces of Kerioth, signaling the city's destruction and the downfall of Moab.
